answer: For a poll ranking designs for a juniper grove, including an atlas display and a horizon mural, the server rejects incomplete rankings. It elects a design only if more ballots rank it above each rival than below; otherwise it reports no winner. If all n honest voters rank the atlas first, making the mural beat it needs at least n+1 opposing ballots, costing submission effort. Automation can make that cheap, cycles can yield no winner, and rankings do not prove identity.
